test a different weighting scheme (softmax_neg_error) to see if a non‑linear weight improves over inverse_error, given unstable ranking and moderate seasonality.
The series shows unstable ranking and a moderate seasonal signal; a simple robust non‑linear combination like median may perform better than mean or weighted.

Test a per‑horizon weighted combination using the best‑per‑horizon handle (w5) to see if horizon‑specific strengths improve over the flat weighted mean.
The series has unstable ranking and moderate seasonality; a per‑horizon top‑k mean could exploit changing best models across horizons.
Test a simple mean combination on the full pool to see if the robust hint favors a plain average over weighted schemes.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9623. Series context: trend strength 0.0 and seasonal strength 0.425; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.103); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.453.
